rows.section: Personal income tax (данък върху доходите на физическите лица, art. 48)
rows.basis: Annual tax base (monthly tax base for salaries): gross income less the employee's social and health insurance and the reliefs
rows.note: A flat 10% applies to the total annual tax base (art. 17). On salaries the employer withholds 10% of the monthly tax base each month. Sole traders (see the items under review) and the final taxes on investment income have their own rates.
rows.source_title: Държавен вестник, бр. 113 от 28.12.2007: Закон за изменение и допълнение на Закона за данъците върху доходите на физическите лица (§ 29 and § 35: art. 42 and art. 48; in force from 1 January 2008)

rows.label: One child under 18: reduction of the annual tax base

rows.note: One parent (or foster parent, relative) claims the relief, in the annual return or, by a one-off written declaration, monthly through one employer. The monthly amounts are one twelfth of the annual reliefs.

rows.section: Employee social and health insurance (born after 31 December 1959)
rows.label: Pension (fund Pensions)
rows.basis: Gross monthly pay, from the minimum insurable income up to the maximum insurable income (€2,111.64 to 31 July, €2,300 from 1 August 2026)
rows.note: The employer withholds the employee's share. Pension, sickness, unemployment and health contributions are split between employer and employee; the employee's contributions are deducted before the income tax is computed.
